name: macicon-tactile
description: Tactile macOS app icon in the Apple Design Award canon (Things, Bear, Tot, Craft) — pillowy materials, soft 3D, niche use case
prefix: macOS/iOS app icon in the Apple Design Award canon — the visual language of Things 3 by Cultured Code, Bear by Shiny Frog, Tot by Iconfactory, Craft by Luki Labs, Linear, and Arc by The Browser Company. The icon IS the squircle — the subject fills the squircle frame as its primary geometry, painted edge-to-edge. Not a small object floating on a background; not an icon nested inside another icon. Distill the concept to a single iconic gesture, not a literal depiction. One bold accent color popping against a restrained warm neutral background. Materials are matte and tactile — paper, ink, fabric, ceramic, wood, painted metal, soft felt — never glossy plastic, never liquid, never glass. Depth comes from one soft diffuse shadow inside the icon and gentle ambient occlusion — never harsh, never purely flat, never with rim light or inner highlights. Reads instantly at 16px and remains beautiful at 1024px
suffix: Centered composition, 1:1 square, single icon as the only subject, generous breathing room, plain backdrop. Made for the Home Screen of a tasteful person
no: small object floating on a background
